content: Debian manpages mke2fs(8) e2fsprogs 1.47.2: -F forces creation even when device or parameters do not make sense; forcing over filesystem that appears in use or mounted requires -F twice (-FF); -n dry-run prints what would be done; script currently uses single -F. Source: https://manpages.debian.org/stable/e2fsprogs/mke2fs.8.en.html
